about: Delson is a city on Montréal’s South Shore in Roussillon, Quebec, a compact railway-junction suburb beside Saint-Constant and Candiac—not those neighbours. Freight yards, a small downtown, and commuter neighbourhoods define this Montérégie city. About 8,000 people live in Delson.
seoSummary: South Shore railway-junction city beside Saint-Constant and Candiac—compact Roussillon suburb, not those neighbours.
